'''Kris Bourgeon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Ottawa tournament]] on 8 July 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2599">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-ottawa-canada-8-7-01d2599/ ottawa-canada-8-7-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-ottawa-canada-8-7-01d2599/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
